description: Issue #35, part 4V lesson 04-23 (externally described files in fixed-form RPG IV, CRTBNDRPG). Compiles the six shipped samples V0423A-E and W0423A (src/qrpglesrc/v0423*s.rpgle, w0423as.rpgle), the exercise answers (solutions/04-23, scratch member names X423*) and five NEGATIVE probes (verify/part04v-23run/src/t423n1-5: RPG III spelling UPDAT/EXCPT, READ EOF indicator and K at the RPG III columns, UPDATE on an input-only file) with OPTION(*EVENTF); the compile event file member of each is copied into VFYEVF so the real RNF/RNS message ids can be read (the harness never ran this EVFEVENT copy before: cl_commands_75.txt says the event file member is in EVFEVENT in the library of the created object, so the copy reads from &LIB, not QTEMP). RUN: V0423A/B/C and exercise programs print through QSYSPRT; per docs/probes.md (part06-decisions-2) the printed lines are read from this connection result's run section, not via CPYSPLF. V0423D mutates ZAIKOM P00001 45 to 43: TXRESET runs before and after, and VFYSTK records snapshots (RESET0, BEFOREV0D, AFTERV0D, RESET1, AFTERLOCK). The library list is reset first (RMVLIBLE then ADDLIBLE POSITION(*FIRST) of &LIB): there is no placeholder for the learner's first library, so &LIB (where the sample DB lives) is the one removed and re-added. LOCK EXPERIMENT (batch vs batch, the pattern part06-p43-lockdiag already confirmed with SHOHIM): SBMJOB V0423E (UF CHAIN of ZAIKOM P00006, no UPDATE, QCMDEXC DLYJOB 30) with INQMSGRPY(*DFT), then DSPRCDLCK, then the wrapper job calls W0423A with OVRDBF WAITRCD(5): expected LOCKED / status 01218 (UNVERIFIED for this fixed-form pair), then after the holder ends W0423A again: expected FOUND / 00000. HANG-PRONE LAST: a second holder is submitted and T423NE (the same tester WITHOUT an error indicator) is called against it: whatever ILE does for an unhandled record-lock time-out (an RNQ1218-style inquiry answered by INQMSGRPY(*DFT), or an RNX escape) lands in the job log (VFYLOG). Level check (CPF4131) and the *LIBL open failure are NOT run here (they would need a shared or scratch PF and an ILE inquiry message that has not been observed); the lesson text marks them unverified. Nothing is written to ZAIKOM except V0423D, which TXRESET undoes.
